jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Head of Product Excellence (f/m/d) for the Steam Turbine and Generator (STG) business no day will look the same. The focus of the team is on collecting and reporting non-conformance data from across all the STG business segments as well as managing the processes for continuous improvement efforts.  Week-to-week, the rhythm changes focus from reporting the figures to evaluation of the results and ensuring the improvement activities are making progress. There are additional tasks that include Document Management, 3i, PCM, auditing and local support for different tasks where the employees are sitting.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Governance for Non-Conformance Cost (NCC) reporting for the STG business. This includes the NCC process, monthly reporting and visualization. Support the extended STG organization for all service lines and functions with information on next steps to help them meet the “not to exceed” targets.
* Governance for the CAPA (Corrective Action and Preventative Action) process. This includes the process, tools and training to ensure CAPA are being executed efficiently and effectively. KPI’s are then tracked by the EQS PE team for progress and reporting.
* Facilitate monthly Quality Ambassador meetings to involve the cross-functional organization with CAPA quality and lessons learned throughout the business
* Manage a diverse team of nine quality professionals who support Non-Conformance Management across five countries
* Oversee the document management system (BIC Cloud/SEPH) and ensure compliance with the SE requirements
* Support the SAP S4Energy transition as Capability Lead for STG EQS.  This responsibility requires working knowledge of the business processes and learning how the new SAP system will work.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in quality management or similar field
* Multiple years of experience in Quality Management or relevant field with proven capabilities for root cause analysis methods, basic statistical analysis tools and interpretation of results
* Knowledge of the ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 Integrated Management System preferred
* Working knowledge of SAP and MS Office Suite; AI Copilot a plus
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written; fluency in English
* Willingness to travel (up to 50%) and ability to flex work time to accommodate different time zones as required

jobs.occupation: Research Engineer (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
The Research Engineer will contribute to driving R&D initiatives within a dynamic industrial setting, focusing on the development of new products, services, and basic knowledge of steel casting fluxes (mold powder for continuous casting of steel) and raw materials. The role encompasses applications in continuous casting of steel. This position bridges laboratory research and plant operations, emphasizing sustainable solutions, process efficiencies, and delivering high-quality results for industrial clients worldwide.

Responsibilities:

1. Project Management :

- Define research programs aligned with new product and service objectives.
- Organize and execute laboratory-scale R&D projects.
- Performs tasks/projects and takes the responsibility for assuring quality, cost effectiveness & timeliness for those projects
- Develop materials and processes while supporting related projects.
- Maintain regular reporting on project progress and outcomes.
- Supervise customer sample preparation and optimize products based on feedback.
- Monitor technical advancements in the market, including patents and scientific publications.
- Consolidate fundamental knowledge on steel casting fluxes and associated raw materials.

2. Laboratory Research and Data Management :

- Plan research activities, including experiments, characterization, and analytics
- Manage, process, analyse, and document data from lab activities.
- Maximize data collection value from R&D, production, and quality assurance.
- Develop project reviews, technical reports, and presentations with clarity and precision.
- Document knowledge and findings in technical memos and share them with stakeholders.
- Utilize project management tools (e.g., Vantage) for deliverables and resource planning.
- Organize stage-gate meetings and prioritize multiple projects.

3. External Collaboration and Scientific Contributions :

- Prepare papers, proposals, and presentations for conferences, congresses, and seminars.
- Build external collaborations and networks to share and extend expertise.
- Address intellectual property topics, support evaluations, and assist in patent filings.

Requirements: 

- PhD or master’s degree in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Mineralogy, or a related engineering discipline, preferably with a focus on casting fluxes (mold powders), glass chemistry, and/or interactions between slag and liquid steel.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D, project management, or product development, ideally within or for a steel plant environment.
- Comprehensive knowledge of continuous steel casting processes, mineralogy, and ceramic raw materials for casting fluxes, including their melting and solidification mechanisms under high-temperature conditions.
- Strong expertise in thermodynamics and reaction kinetics, with proficiency in thermodynamic calculation tools (e.g., FactSage®).
- Hands-on experience with advanced analytical techniques, such as high-temperature viscometry, hot-stage microscopy, TG/DTA, XRD, and Rietveld refinement.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation.
- Strong technical writing and presentation skills, including the ability to clearly summarize research outcomes and present results during stage-gate or project review meetings.
- Motivated, adaptable, and innovative, with a proactive approach to challenges and a strong drive for continuous improvement.
- Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively in an international environment and partner across R&D and plant operations.
- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken.

Expertenkenntnisse: Forschung

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

• 
Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

• 
Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

• 
Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

• 
Bioinformatics

• 
Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

• 
PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

• 
Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

• 
Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

• 
Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

• 
Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

• 
Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

• 
Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

• 
Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

• 
Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

• 
Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

• 
Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

• 
Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

• 
Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

• 
Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

• 
International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 23, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

• 
a motivation letter

• 
a detailed CV

• 
degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

• 
a complete and numbered list of publications

• 
3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

• 
It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

• 
a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

• 
a detailed description of research experience

• 
an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). jobs.occupation: Kitchen assistant, kitchen help - or trained chef
jobs.description:
Attention ladies & gents in Aarhus, or close by  

We are looking for a chef - kitchen assistant or kitchenhelp to our french bistro.

We are 2 small and very cozy restaurants in Jægergårdsgade, Århus, Denmark. And we are pleasantly busy.  

Cheers to the idea that YOU might be one of our new colleagues. We have an ongoing view on all applicants and we welcome new colleagues, when needed. Feel free to send an application to us.

We urge you to go to our SoMe, read about us and see photos of what type of service we do, to get a feel for the atmosphere and the culture we have.

Klassisk Bistro 65, being the characteristic charming French bistro   https://www.klassiskbistro.dk/

Who we are;

We are a wonderful diverse team in nationalities and cultures, around 50 colleagues that come from 12-13 different countries, all over the world - Italy, France, Argentina, UK, Bulgaria, Syria, Slovenia, Poland, Nepal, Russia, DK …. Our spoken language is English with a touch of dialect, charming and very relaxed. 

We are down to earth in mindset and working style, the organisation is flat in structure – so there’s no managers to tell you what to do every 10 minutes, thus we expect you to work independently, focused on your tasks and responsibilities and with an eye for the whole team.

We are looking for the following staff;

Experienced chefs, that have years behind a stow and is used to busy and high pressure service. You are able to keep calm, move fast, make nice food & keep kitchen clean – also when everything is hectic around you. 

Kitchen help, that have min. 6 months experience working in kitchens, helping out with prep for service as well as helping out as a waiter. You are willing to do a lot of helpful stuff when getting ready for service.

We ask of you;

Tattoos, multi-colored trousers, straight hair, no hair, A, B, C, D chest seize, flip beard, mustacho or too much beard…..  We don’t really mind - as long as you have a big smile, are clean, outgoing, service minded, a good helpful colleague, willing to learn new stuff and can move fast in our kitchen. 

Please understand, our team are hardworking people, if you have an addiction problem with drugs, alcohol etc. - you do not need to apply to any of the positions! Its one of our non-negotiables and a key company values.

Acknowledging the importance in following the company rules and guidelines, eg. for best practice in ´cleaning & hygiene´ – is another key factor in our company. We expect of you to be responsible and meet on time and not report sick every second day due to hangovers.

We offer;

·       A lively and nice place to work, no days are alike

·       Salary linked to qualifications (all staff are hourly paid)

·       We teach you, first 3-5 shifts are trial shifts - and you get paid for these too

·       Chance to expand your competencies  

·       Staff food

·       50% discount on your bill for 4 pax, if you eat in the restaurants on certain days

·       Staff trips and staff events over the year – e.g. Ice skating, Tivoli

·       Maybe you join our restaurant Smukfisk at SmukFest festival in Skanderborg

·       Chance to participate in Danish Oyester Cup, when we attend this event

International students that only can work 10-15 hours/week are also welcome. 

Only apply for the job, if you live close by and are able to come to work and stay untill your shift ends at night. Its a non-negotiable.

Please note, getting a job in one of our places is subject to a valid Danish work permit and Danish bank account. So you must be able to get a CPR number (personal identification number ) and a work permit in Denmark.

Please send an e-mail to info@jobsaka.dk with your; application - photo, - and please inform us about where in the process your are, regarding obtaining a Danish work permit.

Header in e-mail MUST clearly state; the job role & if you seek parttime or full time.

If your headder is not displaying this, your applications will not be taken into account, thanks.

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub ligger ved Dragør Havn i en historisk bygning fra 1863. Restauranten har fokus på god mad, god service og en hyggelig atmosfære. Experience as a Sous Chef, Kitchen Supervisor, Team Leader or similar

• 
Organised, reliable and responsible

Able to remain calm during busy services

• 
A central role with responsibility for daily kitchen operations

• 
Close cooperation with the Head Chef and kitchen team

• 
Varied duties within restaurant and private-function operations

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

Salary based on experience and qualifications

• 
Employment on ordinary Danish terms

Are you an experienced international justice analyst motivated by the opportunity to turn complex information and evidence of violations of international law in Belarus into meaningful action for accountability?

Then DIGNITY can offer you an exciting opportunity as Senior Analyst of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB). Join a highly committed international team and play a meaningful role in advancing international justice and accountability. You will enjoy genuine responsibility, be able to shape impactful work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative culture—whether working remotely or from the office.

The IAPB was created in March 2021 as a consortium of Belarusian and international human rights organisations who joined forces to collect, verify, preserve and analyse evidence of violations of international criminal law and international human rights law allegedly committed by Belarusian authorities since 2020. To this end, the platform directly supports national criminal justice authorities and international accountability mechanisms by providing information and evidence. The IAPB’s objective is to achieve accountability of perpetrators and enable redress for the victims. Its operations were recently extended until end of September 2029.

DIGNITY, as the lead organisation of the consortium, hosts the IAPB’s Secretariat within which the position is located. 

Since 1982, DIGNITY has worked for a world free of torture and violence. We are a human rights and development organisation that also runs a rehabilitation clinic in Denmark. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims, and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be held accountable.

About the position

As Senior Analyst your focus will be to ensure that evidence is gathered in line with international standards; that timely and high-quality responses to requests by national and international accountability mechanisms are drafted, involving structuring, drafting and reviewing of submissions and analytical briefs; and that the work of the IAPB’s analysts and open-source researchers is well coordinated. 

Your primary tasks are:

• Overseeing the consolidation and analysis of information and evidence gathered by IAPB’s partners and the secretariat team; 
• Strategic planning as well as overseeing the IAPB’s analytical work to support criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies, in close coordination with the Senior Legal Consultant; 
• Drafting, reviewing and editing of analytical briefs and legal memos for submission to criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies;
• Supervising and coordinating the work conducted by analysts and consultants, including setting priorities/tasks and ensuring high standards of work, in close coordination with the Legal Advisor. 
• Cooperating with prosecution authorities and international mechanisms. 
• Other reasonable duties corresponding to ability and training.
The position is expected to include up to 25 days of travel abroad per year.

We offer you:

• The opportunity to work as part of a highly committed international team of skilled and experienced colleagues, united by a strong sense of purpose and a collaborative team spirit that has been successfully fostered across a remote working environment. 
• The chance to make a tangible contribution to international justice, supporting work that can have concrete, real-world impact for accountability. 
• A high degree of responsibility and meaningful involvement, with the opportunity to shape the work of the platform. 
• A stimulating and purpose-driven working environment, offering opportunities to engage with complex and international criminal law and accountability issues. 
• A supportive and collegial culture, where knowledge-sharing, mutual respect and constructive collaboration are valued. 
• The flexibility of an office environment or remote working environment, combined with an established culture of communication, collaboration and connection across the team.

Skills

We expect you to hold a university degree in law (at undergraduate or postgraduate level), preferably with a specialisation in international criminal law.

We also expect that you have:

• A minimum of 10 years of demonstrated practical professional experience in the documentation of violations of international law, preferably in the context of international criminal law. This experience should include substantial hands-on investigative or documentation work and not be primarily academic in nature. 
• A minimum of 5 years analytical and investigative experience in relation to violations of international criminal law, in particular crimes against humanity, including the assessment and analysis of relevant facts, evidence, and applicable legal frameworks. 
• Demonstrated legal drafting skills, including experience in conceptualising, structuring and drafting of submissions to national and international human rights and accountability bodies. 
• Demonstrated experience coordinating and overseeing the work of a team of analysts, including allocating and reviewing work and providing substantive guidance to members of the IAPB team in a remote working environment. 
• Experience with universal and extra-territorial jurisdiction cases. 
• Demonstrated experience liaising with criminal justice stakeholders, including national and/or international accountability bodies. 
• Experience representing an organisation at external events, including conferences or other forums, with the confidence to speak to a range of audiences.
• Excellent command of written and spoken English. 
• Fluency in Russian and/or Belarusian will be given particular weight in the selection process.
• Direct experience interviewing survivors and witnesses is desirable.
It is also important that you have:

• Excellent communication skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with different target audiences.
• Strategic thinking.
• Strong organisational and inter-personal skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an inter-disciplinary environment and across different cultures.
• Ability to work across a broad portfolio, manage complex workload and be responsive to evolving demands.
• Cultural and context sensitivity, high ethical standards, and diplomatic skills.
• and that you are resourceful, creative, collegial, empathic, and respectful.

Terms of employment

The position is placed in the Secretariat of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB), of which DIGNITY is the lead organisation. The IAPB is managed by the Head of the Platform and Dignity’s Director of the Prevention & Accountability Department.

The position is placed in Dignity’s head office in Copenhagen (Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Kbh. Ø), but we alternatively offer an employer of record (EoR) solution if you are based in another EU member state. Please note that the position will not be filled on a consultancy basis.

The employment is based on the Danish collective agreement for academics in the Danish State, and the salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 50-52.500 (gross, monthly) + pension (18,07%). If you are offered an EoR solution, the salary will depend on comparable positions and terms of employment in the host country.

Expected entry is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter; the position is currently envisaged until 30 September 2029. 

More info

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting the IAPB Secretariat at iapb@dignity.dk.

Applications with CV, letter of motivation, diploma and any other relevant documents are submitted via the link no later than 27 September 2026.

We expect to hold interviews on 15-16 October 2026 digitally, and possibly also a second round of interviews on 20-21 October 2026, which will also take place digitally.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/

The IAPB is composed of two Belarusian co-lead organisations, Human Rights Center Viasna and International Committee for the Investigation of Torture in Belarus, and its lead organisation DIGNITY – Danish Institute against Torture. 

Since its establishment, it has continued to expand its evidence base and analytical outputs, collecting testimonies of some 2,900 victims and witnesses, over 38,000 victim-related documents and over 2.1 million open-source items, including extensive audiovisual and textual materials. 

Cooperation with accountability mechanisms contributed to the decision of the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court to open an investigation into crimes against humanity related to the Lithuania/Belarus situation. Overall, by June 2026, the Platform had responded to 14 requests from national jurisdictions and prepared 13 submissions to multiple international mechanisms.

As part of its survivor-centred approach, so far it has provided mental health and psychosocial support to 850 beneficiaries. 

Beyond documentation and support activities, the IAPB promotes accountability pathways for Belarus, outlined in its report “Paths to Accountability for Belarus”.

jobs.occupation: CE-Licensed Drivers Wanted for Night and Evening Shifts

FragtDK ApS is experiencing increased demand and is therefore looking for 2–4 new, experienced, and reliable drivers holding a Category CE driving licence.

jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English
·         Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

jobs.occupation: Allround-håndværker søges til fast ansættelse/All-round tradesperson wanted for full-time position
jobs.description:
Dansk:

Vi søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst allround-håndværker, som har primært erfaring og gode faglige kompetencer inden for tømrer- og malerfaget.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil blandt andet omfatte tømrerarbejde og mindre renoveringsopgaver, opbygning og afretning af undergulve, lægning af klikgulve, lamelgulve og massive trægulve samt montering af lister, paneler, aflslibning af trægulve og behandling af trægulve. Derudover vil arbejdet bestå af spartling, opsætning af filt og maling af vægge, lofter og træværk.

Der kan også forekomme reparationer, vedligeholdelse og forskellige mindre håndværksopgaver, som kan berøre eller trække på andre håndværksfag.

Vi leder efter en fagligt dygtig og alsidig person med relevant brancheerfaring. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og levere et pænt resultat med fokus på kvalitet og detaljer.

Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk. Kørekort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder fast fuldtidsansættelse med ordnede forhold, løn efter kvalifikationer og varierede opgaver i Storkøbenhavn og Nordsjælland. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og høj faglig kvalitet vægtes højt.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt mandag til fredag kl. 7.00–15.00. Opstart hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Hvis stillingen lyder som noget for dig, bedes du sende en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@gp-byggeservice.dk.

English:

We are looking for an experienced and responsible all-round tradesperson with strong practical skills and experience, primarily within carpentry and painting.

The work will include carpentry and minor renovation projects, building and levelling subfloors, installing click flooring, engineered flooring and solid wooden floors, as well as fitting trims, skirting boards, floor sanding and floor coating. The position will also involve filling, installing wall lining and painting walls, ceilings and woodwork.

There may also be various repair and maintenance tasks, as well as smaller assignments involving other building trades.

We are looking for a skilled and versatile professional with relevant industry experience. You must be able to work independently, take responsibility for your assignments and deliver high-quality results with attention to detail.

You must be able to communicate in Danish or English. A valid driver’s licence is an advantage but not a requirement.

We offer permanent full-time employment with proper working conditions, salary based on qualifications and varied projects across Greater Copenhagen and North Zealand. You will join a company with a positive working environment where teamwork, responsibility and professional quality are highly valued.

Working hours are generally Monday to Friday from 7:00 to 15:00. The position is available for an immediate start or by agreement.

If this position sounds suitable for you, please send a short application and your CV to info@gp-byggeservice.dk.
